<!-- generated by scripts/cli-reference.mjs from `goback docs`; do not edit -->

Manage the store key that encrypts names and contents before upload

```sh
goback [global flags] key <command>
```

## key new

Generate a store key file

```sh
goback [global flags] key new [flags] <name>
```

| Flag | Description | Environment | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--out value` | key file to write |  | `store.key` |

## key escrow

Wrap a store key under a passphrase as an armored age file, which `age -d` also opens, and print it or keep it with the store

```sh
goback [global flags] key escrow [flags]
```

| Flag | Description | Environment | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--key value` | key file to escrow |  | `store.key` |
| `--passphrase value` | escrow passphrase | `GOBACK_PASSPHRASE` |  |
| `--upload` | keep the escrowed key with the store --storage names, instead of printing it |  |  |

## key id

Print the id of a store key, which names it in the store and in its escrowed copies

```sh
goback [global flags] key id [flags]
```

| Flag | Description | Environment | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--key value` | key file |  | `store.key` |

## key recover

Rebuild a key file from an escrowed key and its passphrase

```sh
goback [global flags] key recover [flags]
```

| Flag | Description | Environment | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--escrow value` | escrowed key file, as printed by escrow; - reads standard input |  | `-` |
| `--out value` | key file to write |  | `store.key` |
| `--passphrase value` | escrow passphrase | `GOBACK_PASSPHRASE` |  |

## key at-rest

Generate the key a local, gcs:// or s3:// store seals its archives with, or rotate it

```sh
goback [global flags] key at-rest [flags]
```

| Flag | Description | Environment | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--out value` | key file to write |  | `at-rest.key` |
| `--rotate` | add a fresh primary key to the file; the keys it held still open what they sealed |  |  |
